name: prod_validation_vista
purpose: §5 production-mode validation: lazy drift mode ON (GIZMO_LAZY_DRIFT_ENABLE=1) but ALL diagnostic stdout OFF (no GIZMO_VERBOSE_DIAG, replaces old GIZMO_STEP_PHASES + GIZMO_NGB_QUIET). Confirms (1) cpu.txt fires on domain-decomp boundaries via the §3a broadened trigger even without OUTPUT_ADDITIONAL_RUNINFO, (2) stdout has zero diagnostic spam, (3) perf matches the 692850 ~153-step baseline (no regression from added stdout-gate checks).
